    This section provides an overview of 1830 Photonic Service Switch (PSS) product family, describing the configurations, system profile and network solutions of the system. This document focuses on the support of 1830 PSS-8, 1830 PSS-16, 1830 PSS-16II, 1830 PSS-32, 1830 PSI-4L and 1830 PSI-8L. The system supports two software load-lines: SWDM software and OCS software. Each software load-line may support only a subset of the shelves.
